title: Closure position
description: JSON Schema for a closure-position cell: the four-valued enumeration {derivation, procedure, process, inquiry} naming the joint (σ-fixed?, Δ-fixed?) settlement-status.

sigma-fixed.description: Whether the σ-nucleus (knowledge-axis closure) is at its fixed point for this entry.

delta-fixed.description: Whether the Δ-nucleus (truth-axis stabilization) is at its fixed point for this entry.
